unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 23-BET. Unit 5 — vaqt predloglari va 1-5-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  3-mashq (Anjela Devis matni, 10 predlog): at, in, on, at, at, at, In, at, On, on.
  3b (9 ta ravish, foizi bilan): always, always, usually, sometimes, rarely, usually, often, usually, never.
  4-mashq (12 bo'shliq): at/in, on, at, on, in, at, on/in, in, in, on.
  5-mashq (20 bo'shliq): Does/does, Are/am, Do/don't-do, Do/don't, Does/doesn't-doesn't, Are/are, Are/aren't, is/isn't-doesn't, Are/aren't, am/am-'m not.
  6-mashq — 'too?' bilan savol tuzish.

⚠ 5-MAShQ ENG QIYIN QISM — QAYSI YORDAMChI FE'L?
  Savolda 'BE' (am/is/are) bo'lsa → javobda ham BE
     'ARE you Mr Stewart?' → 'Yes, I AM.'
  Savolda ODDIY FE'L bo'lsa → do/does
     'DO you watch TV?' → 'No, I DON'T.'
  ⚠ 8-band ikkalasini ARALAShTIRADI: 'IS James at home?' → 'No, he ISN'T. He DOESN'T get home before 6' — birinchi javob 'be', ikkinchisi 'do' bilan, chunki ikkinchi gapda oddiy fe'l ('get') bor.

⚠ 3b — FOIZLAR: kitob ravishlarni foiz bilan bermagan; biz matndan chiqarib, har biriga taxminiy chastota qo'shdik (100% always, 75% usually, 50% often, 25% sometimes, 10% rarely, 0% never). Bu — o'rganishni osonlashtirish uchun, kitobda yo'q.

⚠ 4-mashq 6-band: 'AT weekends' — britancha. Amerikachada 'ON weekends'.
⚠ 4-mashq 7-band: 'ON 1st December' (aniq sana) va 'IN 1971' (yil) — bir gapda ikki xil predlog.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in at, in or on, then underline the adverbs of frequency.
exercises.instructionUz: at, in yoki on ni qo'ying, so'ng takrorlanish ravishlarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — Anjela Devis, o'qituvchining kundalik tartibi.

IKKI VAZIFA BIR VAQTDA:
  1) 10 ta predlog bo'shlig'ini to'ldirish
  2) matndagi BARCHA takrorlanish ravishlarini topish

PREDLOG TANLASH:
  soat (7 o'clock, 8:30, half past seven) → AT
  kun qismi (the morning, the evenings)   → IN
  kun nomi (weekdays, Saturdays, Sunday mornings) → ON

DIQQAT: 7 va 9-bo'shliqlar GAP BOSHIDA — katta harf bilan.

lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. RAVISH: 'always' — 'gets up' dan oldin.

lines.hintUz: 'the morning' — kun qismi, kun nomi yo'q
lines.whyUz: Kun qismi → IN the morning.
Kunlar → ON weekdays (= dushanbadan jumagacha).

lines.textEn: She always has a shower and she usually has breakfast 4) ____ about half past seven.
lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. RAVISHLAR: 'always' va 'usually' — ikkalasi ham fe'ldan oldin.
Soat → AT. 'get to' = yetib bormoq.

lines.textEn: ... and sometimes she corrects homework before the lessons.
lines.uz: ...va ba'zan darsdan oldin uy vazifalarini tekshiradi.
lines.whyUz: RAVISH: 'sometimes' — bu yerda EGADAN OLDIN turibdi, bu ham to'g'ri.

lines.textEn: She leaves work 6) ____ 4 o'clock and rarely gets home after five.
lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. RAVISH: 'rarely' — 'gets' dan oldin. 'leave work' = ishdan chiqmoq.

lines.textEn: 7) ____ the evenings Angela cooks or listens to music.
lines.whyUz: Kun qismi → IN the evenings. Gap boshida katta harf.

lines.textEn: She usually goes to bed 8) ____ about half past eleven.
lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. RAVISH: 'usually' — 'goes' dan oldin.

lines.textEn: 9) ____ Saturdays, she often sees her friends.
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi → ON Saturdays. Gap boshida katta harf. RAVISH: 'often'.

lines.textEn: They usually go out for dinner or to the cinema.
lines.uz: Ular odatda kechki ovqatga yoki kinoga chiqishadi.
lines.whyUz: RAVISH: 'usually' — 'go out' dan oldin.

lines.textEn: Angela never gets up early 10) ____ Sunday mornings.
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi bo'lsa ON ('in the mornings' EMAS). RAVISH: 'never'.

lines.textEn: Sunday is her day to relax.

exercises.instructionEn: Then underline the adverbs of frequency.
exercises.explanationUz:
Matnda TO'QQIZ ta takrorlanish ravishi bor.
Har birini toping va qaysi fe'lga tegishli ekanini ayting.

ESLATMA — ravish o'rni:
  oddiy fe'l bilan → OLDIN
  'to be' bilan    → KEYIN
  'sometimes' esa gap BOSHIDA yoki EGADAN OLDIN ham kelishi mumkin

items.textEn: She ____ gets up at 7 o'clock. (100%)
She ____ has a shower. (100%)
She ____ has breakfast at about half past seven. (75%)
____ she corrects homework before the lessons. (25%)
items.whyUz: 25% → sometimes. Bu yerda EGADAN OLDIN turibdi — 'sometimes' uchun bu ham to'g'ri.

items.textEn: She ____ gets home after five. (10%)
items.whyUz: 10% → rarely. 'not often' bilan bir xil ma'no.

items.textEn: She ____ goes to bed at about half past eleven. (75%)
On Saturdays, she ____ sees her friends. (50%)
They ____ go out for dinner. (75%)
items.whyUz: 75% → usually. 'go out for dinner' = kechki ovqatga chiqmoq.

items.textEn: Angela ____ gets up early on Sunday mornings. (0%)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in on, in or at.
exercises.instructionUz: on, in yoki at ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'nta gap, ba'zilarida IKKI bo'shliq.

QOIDANI ESLANG:
  AT — soat, the weekend, night, noon
  ON — hafta kunlari, aniq kunning qismlari, sanalar
  IN — oylar, fasllar, yillar, the morning/evening/afternoon

items.textEn: 1  I usually wake up ____ 6 o'clock ... (1-bo'shliq)
1  ... ____ the morning. (2-bo'shliq)
2  Joe never goes shopping ____ Saturdays.
items.whyUz: Hafta kuni → ON. 'on Saturdays' = har shanba.

items.textEn: 3  Hurry! The film starts ____ 8 o'clock.
4  I often get up late ____ Monday mornings.
items.whyUz: Kun nomi bor → ON ('in the mornings' EMAS).

items.textEn: 5  What do you do ____ the evening?
6  Kelly often meets her friends ____ weekends.
items.whyUz: Britan inglizchasida 'at weekends' / 'at the weekend'. AQShda 'on weekends'.

items.textEn: 7  Howard was born ____ 1st December, ... (1-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: Sana → ON. '1st December' = the first of December.
Yil → IN. Bir gapda ikkala predlog.

items.textEn: 8  She loves going for walks ____ the spring.
9  We usually go on holiday ____ July.
10  I like working in the garden ____ Sunday afternoons.
items.whyUz: Kun nomi bor → ON ('in the afternoons' EMAS).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in do(n't), does(n't), am(not), is(n't) or are(n't).
exercises.instructionUz: do(n't), does(n't), am(not), is(n't) yoki are(n't) — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH FE'L — ularni ADASHTIRMANG:

  'to be' fe'li: am / is / are
    Sifat, ot yoki JOY bilan ishlatiladi:
      Are you Mr Stewart?      (ot)
      Are they from Argentina? (kelib chiqish)
      Are the children in the garden?  (joy)
      I am an Oasis fan.       (ot)

  'do/does' yordamchi fe'li:
    ODDIY FE'L bilan ishlatiladi:
      Does Brian get up early?  ('get up' fe'li)
      Do you watch TV?          ('watch' fe'li)
      Does he make dinner?      ('make' fe'li)

TEKSHIRUV: gapda oddiy fe'l bormi?
  Bor  → do / does
  Yo'q → am / is / are

EGAGA QARAB:
  I → am / do
  he, she, it → is / does
  you, we, they → are / do

lines.whyUz: Oddiy fe'l bor → DOES (3-shaxs birlik). 'to be' EMAS.
Savolda 'Does' → javobda 'does'.
Fe'l yo'q, ism bor → 'to be'. 'you' bilan ARE.

lines.textEn: Yes, I ____ . Nice to meet you.
lines.whyUz: 'I' bilan AM. 'Nice to meet you' = tanishganimdan xursandman.
Oddiy fe'l → DO. Ravish 'usually' ega va fe'l orasida.
'I' bilan don't. 'my sisters' ko'plik → do.

lines.textEn: ____ you go to the gym on Saturdays?
lines.whyUz: Oddiy fe'l → DO.

lines.textEn: No, I ____ . I usually go climbing.
lines.whyUz: 'I' bilan don't.
3-shaxs birlik → DOES. Ravish 'often' ega va fe'l orasida.
'he' bilan doesn't. Ikkinchisida ham — 'like' oddiy fe'l.
Fe'l yo'q, joy bor → 'to be'. 'children' ko'plik → ARE.
'they' bilan are.
'be from' — kelib chiqish. 'they' → ARE.
'they' bilan aren't.

lines.hintUz: Oddiy fe'l YO'Q — faqat JOY ('at home')
lines.whyUz: Joy bilan 'to be'. 'James' 3-shaxs birlik → IS. Telefonda so'rash.

lines.textEn: No, he ____ . He ____ get home before 6 o'clock.
lines.hintUz: Birinchisi 'to be', ikkinchisida oddiy fe'l 'get' bor
lines.whyUz: Birinchi gapda fe'l yo'q → isn't. Ikkinchisida 'get home' fe'li bor → doesn't.
'these' ko'plik + fe'l yo'q → ARE. 'glasses' doim ko'plikda.
'they' bilan aren't.
Fe'l yo'q, ot bor → 'to be'. 'I' → AM. Oasis — britaniyalik rok guruh.

lines.textEn: I ____ , too but I ____ a Spice Girls fan.
lines.whyUz: 'I am, too' = men ham. Inkor: 'I'm not' ('I amn't' YO'Q — ingliz tilida bunday shakl yo'q).

exercises.instructionEn: Form questions using the prompts below, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  Bill goes to the gym. (Claire)
  → Does Claire go to the gym, too?

QADAMLAR:
  1) Qavsdagi ODAMNI ega qiling
  2) Ega 3-shaxs birlikmi yoki ko'plikmi — aniqlang
     birlik → Does ...?
     ko'plik → Do ...?
  3) Fe'lni ASOS shakliga qaytaring (-s tushadi)
     goes → go,  loves → love,  plays → play,  hates → hate
  4) Oxiriga ', too?' qo'shing

EGALIK SIFATINI ham o'zgartiring:
  David plays ... in HIS free time.
  → Do Joe and Ian play ... in THEIR free time?

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: Bill goes to the gym. (Claire) → Does Claire go to the gym, too?
example.uz: Bill sport zaliga boradi. (Kler) → Kler ham sport zaliga boradimi?

modelSentences.word: 2. Elizabeth loves going dancing at weekends. (Karl)
modelSentences.sentence: Does Karl love going dancing at weekends, too?
modelSentences.uz: Karl ham dam olish kunlari raqsga borishni yaxshi ko'radimi?

modelSentences.word: 3. David plays computer games in his free time. (Joe and Ian)
modelSentences.sentence: Do Joe and Ian play computer games in their free time, too?
modelSentences.uz: Jou va Ian ham bo'sh vaqtida kompyuter o'yini o'ynaydimi?
Pam ham chodirda dam olishni yomon ko'radimi?

modelSentences.word: 5. Brandon wakes up early on Sundays. (your parents)
modelSentences.sentence: Do your parents wake up early on Sundays, too?
modelSentences.uz: Sizning ota-onangiz ham yakshanba kunlari erta turadimi?

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 23-bet — yordamchi fe'llar va turg'un birikmalar.

groups.explanationUz: Gapda ODDIY FE'L bormi? — hal qiluvchi savol.

items.base: Are the children in the garden?

groups.explanationUz: 'to be' ning inkor qisqartmalarida bitta istisno bor.
'get' — ingliz tilining eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llaridan biri.

items.derived: She doesn't go out during the week.

patterns.exampleEn: She always gets up at 7 o'clock in the morning on weekdays.
patterns.exampleUz: U ish kunlari ertalab soat yettida doim turadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir gapda UCHTA vaqt predlogi:
AT (soat) → IN (kun qismi) → ON (kunlar).
Tartib: aniqdan umumiyga.

patterns.exampleEn: Does Brian get up early? — Yes, he does.
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan do/does. Fe'l -s OLMAYDI.

patterns.exampleEn: Are you Mr Stewart? — Yes, I am. Are the children in the garden? — Yes, they are.
patterns.exampleUz: Siz janob Styuartmisiz? — Ha. Bolalar bog'dami? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bo'lmasa 'to be' ishlatiladi — do/does KERAK EMAS.

patterns.formula: No, I don't, BUT my sisters do.
patterns.exampleEn: Do you usually watch TV? — No, I don't, but my sisters do.
patterns.exampleUz: Siz odatda televizor ko'rasizmi? — Yo'q, lekin opa-singillarim ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' dan keyin fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat yordamchi qoladi ('do').

patterns.exampleEn: Bill goes to the gym. → Does Claire go to the gym, too?
patterns.exampleUz: Bill sport zaliga boradi. → Kler ham boradimi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'too' = ham. Gap oxirida vergul bilan.
Fe'l ASOS shakliga qaytadi: goes → go.

patterns.formula: I am, too but I'm not a ... fan.
patterns.exampleEn: I am an Oasis fan. — I am, too but I'm not a Spice Girls fan.
patterns.exampleUz: Men Oasis muxlisiman. — Men ham, lekin Spice Girls muxlisi emasman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I am, too' — rozilik. 'I'm not' — inkor.
'I amn't' shakli ingliz tilida YO'Q.
